The ASAN runtime library isn't found. Let me check what clang version is installed and look for the runtime in other locations:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'which clang; clang --version 2>&1 | head -3; find / -name "libclang_rt.asan*" 2>/dev/null | head -10' 2>&1 | head -15</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
